title: Nobody knows where the next meteor will be
description:
Astronomers say Leonid meteor streaks trace back to the constellation Leo. The Leonids peak in mid-November each year, and again this week.
NASA picture: HQ, NHQ202508030001. NASA/Bill Ingalls, 3 Aug 2025.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Luo Hongyang: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-15-leonid-meteors-through-orion/. To use it, please ask the owner.
